scripture.verse: "Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall."

sermons.title: Sermon 2114 | The Burden of the Word of the Lord

scripture.verse: "The burden of the Word of the Lord."

sermons.title: Sermon 2115 | The Drought of Nature, the Rain of Grace and the Lesson Therefrom

scripture.verse: "And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits and found no water. They returned with their vessels empty. They were ashamed and confounded and covered their heads. Because the ground is parched, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they co vered their heads. Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? Or can the hea vens give showers? Are not you He, O Lord our God? Therefore we will wait upon You: for You have made all these things."

sermons.title: Sermon 2116 | The Unchanging God Cheering Jacob in His Change of Dwelling Place

scripture.verse: "And Israel took his journey with all that he had and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac. And God spoke unto Israel in the visions of the night and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I. And He said, I am God, the God of your father: fear not to go down into Egypt. For I will there make of you a great nation: I will go down with you into Egypt. And I will also surely bring you up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon your eyes."

sermons.title: Sermon 2117 | The Father's Love to His Dying Son

scripture.verse: "Therefore does My Father love Me, because I lay down My life, that I might take it again."

sermons.title: Sermon 2118 | The Planter of the Ear Must Hear

scripture.verse: "He that planted the ear, shall He not hear? He that formed the eye, shall He not see?"

sermons.title: Sermon 2119 | Magdalene at the Sepulcher—an Instructive Scene

scripture.verse: "Then the disciples went away again unto their own homes. But Mary stood without at the sepulcher weeping: and as she wept, she stooped do wn and looked into the sepulcher and saw two angels in white sitting, the one at the head and the other at the feet, where the Body of Jesus had lain. And they said unto her, Woman, why do you weep? She said unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord and I know not where they have laid Him. And when she had thus said, she turned herself back and saw Jesus standing and knew not that it was Jesus. Jesus said unto her, Woman, why do you weep? Whom do you seek? She, supposing Him to be the gardener, said unto Him, Sir, if you have borne Him, therefore, tell me where you have laid Him and I will take Him away. Jesus said unto her, Mary. She turned herself and said unto Him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master."

sermons.title: Sermon 2120 | The Security Of Believers—Or, Sheep Who Shall Never Perish

scripture.verse: "My sheep hear My voice and I know them and they follow Me: and I give unto them eternal life. And they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of My hand. My Father, which gave them Me is greater than all. And no man is able to pluck them out of My Father's hand. I and my Father are one."

sermons.title: Sermon 2121 | The Keynote of the Year

scripture.verse: "Bless the Lord, O my Soul: and all that is within me, bless His holy name."
